hypotheses.construction_plan: Define a latent two-slot kernel K(a,b)=T(a,b). Generate the first displayed term by identity on K with slots (a,b)=(i,j). Generate the second displayed term by permuting the two slots of K, giving K(j,i)=T(j,i). The full expression is the sum of these two operator images over the S2 orbit of the argument pair.
required_assumptions: T accepts two ordered index arguments.
Permutation acts by swapping the two argument positions.
hypotheses.rationale: The expression is the order-2 sum over the symmetric group S2 acting on the argument positions of T. The two non-identical terms are generated by the identity and permutation operators applied to one latent kernel.
